summary: Busy church-side car park on a main road corner, mostly full, homes beyond 20 m.
reasons: Dwellings 24 m or more from north edge

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings 24 m and 13 m at the south-west end; church and Sunday school are non-residential; the lot is in open view of both roads.
drivers.access_and_room: Open entry from the road corner; about 25 cars parked in imagery, with gaps near the north-west edge.
drivers.traffic: Wide arterial on the east and a busy side street on the north; noise and headlights likely.
drivers.convention: Church and street parking, with 4P meter signs on Edmondstone Street; no camping seen.

flags: Slope steep towards the south end: up to 31.8% max grade near the house, though the best section is about 1.6%
Meter sign 4P Mon-Fri 10am-5pm on Edmondstone Street
sun_shade: Open to sun on all sides; a tree on the north-east corner shades a little in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the lot is private church or customer parking

best_section.where: North-west edge of the car park, by the Edmondstone Street side
